intent_en: To explain the factors driving WeWork's high valuation in contrast to the traditional profitability of Regus.
previous_intent: To contrast the steady profitability of Regus between 2013 and 2017 with the significantly higher valuation of WeWork, questioning the rationale behind the latter's market worth.
narration_support: Regis actually makes a profit... The question is, what makes WeWork worth that extra
chart_support: Bar chart showing Regus profit increasing from 2013 to 2017
evidence_note: Narration (with typo 'Regis' for Regus) highlights Regus's profitability and questions WeWork's extra valuation. Chart visualizes Regus profit growth over the period 2013-2017, supporting the claim of profitability.
